title: Medical facility
description: One record: one hospital, clinic or doctor from an official government list of medical facilities for travellers in one country, with the list's own title, link and updated date (lists can be years old; show their age). Voyager use: emergency_card (hospitals).

name.description: Facility or practitioner name as written.

country.description: Country in English (e.g. "Japan"). Required whenever `city` is set.

city.description: City in English, only when the list states it. Always paired with `country`.

section.description: The list section the entry appears under, as written (often a city, region or specialty).

phones.description: Phone numbers, each exactly as written plus E.164 when it is unambiguous.

e164.description: E.164 form, only when the written number is already in international form (never derived from a local number).

website_url.description: The facility's website, as linked by the list.

list_title.description: Title of the list the entry comes from.

list_updated.description: The date the list itself was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

issuer.description: The government body that publishes the list.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
